description: This Java test class performs benchmarking tests for the JavaScriptMessageMapperRhino component in the Eclipse Ditto project. It contains multiple test methods that execute various payload mapping scenarios (text, binary, JSON formatting and parsing, construction, etc.) and verifies the resultant Adaptable objects with assertions. The class references several external classes related to messaging, JSON handling, and the Ditto platform, and defines specific test functions for scenario execution and validation.

classes.name: JavaScriptMessageMapperRhinoBenchmarkTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that benchmarks and validates JSON message mappings for the Rhino-based JavaScript message mapper within the Eclipse Ditto project.

methods.name: simpleMapTextPayload
methods.description: Test method that maps a simple text payload to a Ditto Adaptable and verifies the default properties and payload content.

methods.name: test1DecodeBinaryPayloadToDitto
methods.description: Test decoding a binary payload into Ditto format and verifies payload content.

methods.name: test2ParseJsonPayloadToDitto
methods.description: Test parsing a JSON payload into Ditto format and verifies specific JSON field values.

methods.name: test3FormatJsonPayloadToDitto
methods.description: Test formatting a JSON payload for Ditto and checks default Adaptable properties.

methods.name: test4ConstructJsonPayloadToDitto
methods.description: Test constructing a JSON payload for Ditto and verifies specific JSON fields.

methods.name: test5DecodeBinaryToDitto
methods.description: Test decoding a binary data representing sensor readings into Ditto format with payload verification.

methods.name: runScenario
methods.description: Helper method that executes a scenario to map an ExternalMessage using the specified MessageMapper.

methods.name: assertDefaults
methods.description: Utility method to verify that an Adaptable object has the expected default topic path properties.
